proposal.hypothesis: A factor-two target tile with 64 threads and 128 outputs per block preserves source-register reuse while changing CTA size and scheduling relative to the measured 128-thread factor-two candidate. Smaller per-CTA resource reservation may affect residency, but the effect is hardware-dependent; prior coarsened candidates were slower than baseline, so no speedup is assumed.

retained: Keep two output targets per thread, with the second target at threadIdx.x + blockDim.x, so each streamed source position and mass can be reused across both targets.
Set launch block size to 64 threads and items_per_block to 128; retain zero shared-memory allocation.
Retain per-target validity and self-interaction checks so arbitrary N and partial final tiles remain covered.
